## PresenceRequirementOptions interface

Options common to every backend-touching operation that can be gated on a fresh, per-use human presence action.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PresenceRequirementOptions 
```

## Remarks

When `requirePresencePerUse` is `true`<!-- -->, the operation refuses — with a [NotCapableError](./vaultkeeper.notcapableerror.md)<!-- -->, before any credential, session, or device is touched — unless the active backend's configured instance advertises [BackendCapabilities.presencePerUse](./vaultkeeper.backendcapabilities.presenceperuse.md)<!-- -->. When the backend is capable, the operation proceeds through the backend's ordinary path, which (by the meaning of the capability) forces a distinct fresh human action for this specific call; a cached or session-unlocked state can never satisfy it. Capabilities are queried fresh on every call and never cached across operations.
